# gold-price.app

> Live gold, silver, platinum, and palladium spot prices in multiple currencies, with interactive charts and unit conversions.

## About
Gold-Price.app provides live gold prices in multiple currencies. Real-time spot prices, historical charts, and price tracking for gold, silver, platinum, and palladium.

## Features / Content
- Live spot prices updated approximately every 60 seconds
- Precious metals covered: Gold (XAU), Silver (XAG), Platinum (XPT), Palladium (XPD)
- Prices per troy ounce, per gram, and per kilo
- Supported currencies: USD, EUR, GBP, CNY, INR, AUD, CAD, MYR
- Price change and percentage change displayed for each metal
- Interactive TradingView charts for each metal
- Gold/Silver ratio indicator
- Value calculator (enter an amount in oz, grams, or kilos to get its worth)
- Light and dark theme
- Installable as a PWA (Progressive Web App)

## Sections
- [Homepage](https://gold-price.app/): Live prices, charts, unit converter, and metal selector
- [Disclaimer](https://gold-price.app/disclaimer.html): Financial disclaimer — informational use only

## URL Patterns
- English (default): https://gold-price.app/
- Localized versions use a language-code prefix: https://gold-price.app/{lang}/
  - Examples: /de/, /es/, /fr/, /it/, /pt/, /zh/, /ja/, /hi/, /ru/, /tr/, /ms/
- Legal pages live at the root: /disclaimer.html, /privacy.html, /terms.html

## Data Sources
- Precious metal spot prices: Kitco (https://proxy.kitco.com/getPM) for gold (AU), silver (AG), platinum (PT), palladium (PD); refreshed approximately every 60 seconds
- Currency exchange rates: exchangerate-api.com (https://api.exchangerate-api.com/v4/latest/USD)
- Charts: TradingView advanced chart embed widget (TVC:GOLD, TVC:SILVER, TVC:PLATINUM, TVC:PALLADIUM)
